BiblicalUsage: The King James reads the church in Smyrna, where the older Greek text has the word for a Smyrnaean, one of the people of Smyrna. The letter is addressed to the angel of that church, from the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the letter belongs to the people of the place, not only to the place, and the risen Lord speaks to His church wherever it gathers.
